meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: Claude 会一步步带你为一个聊天频道创建第一个 NanoClaw 机器人：先让你选频道、填自己的用户 ID、显示名和机器人名字，然后自动完成设置，让机器人给你发一条欢迎私信，并等你确认收到。重复运行也没有副作用。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行的前提下，当你请 Claude 为某个已接入的频道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent 时，此流程开始。典型入口：新配好频道后想验证机器人发私信。

say.text: 请为Telegram创建第一个NanoClaw agent，并验证。
say.note: 它会先让你确认账号身份，然后配置并发欢迎消息。

say.text: 为我的账号初始化第一个 agent，并让它发条欢迎私信给我。
say.note: 它会让你选出频道、填好显示名，然后完成连接。

say.text: 帮我把第一个 NanoClaw 机器人接到 Slack，测试欢迎 DM。
say.note: 你先给机器人发条私信，它才能识别你的 DM 会话。

howto.what_en: Walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent on a channel: choose channel, provide user ID / display name / agent name; it wires the agent and sends you a welcome DM for confirmation. Rerunning is safe.
howto.when_en: Use after credentials are configured and the service is running. It starts when you ask Claude to create the first NanoClaw agent on an installed channel, e.g. to verify that the channel can DM.

say_en.text: Please create the first NanoClaw agent on Telegram and verify it.
say_en.note: It confirms your account, sets up, and sends the welcome DM.

say_en.text: Initialize the first agent on my account and have it send me a welcome DM.
say_en.note: It asks for channel and display name, then completes the setup.

say_en.text: Help me connect the first NanoClaw bot to Slack and test the welcome DM.
say_en.note: You need to DM the bot once so it recognizes your session.
